title: TactfulToM: Do LLMs Have the Theory of Mind Ability to Understand White Lies?
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the ability of LLMs to understand 'white lies', which are intentional falsehoods told for prosocial reasons such as protecting others' feelings or maintaining social harmony. This evaluation requires models to perform moral reasoning regarding the justification of deception in social contexts, specifically looking at prosocial motivations versus simple truth-telling.
